featured_reviews.name: Zoshua Colah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Good place to rent cycles from. The brakes are not great but for an experienced rider they are really good. They have very reasonable rates (compared to others) and are really nice and give you a cycle according to your needs. They also are not very strict about the rental time and if you take longer than the time you said you would you can just pay them the remaining balance when you return.

I prefer them over happy cycles in colaba because of this.

featured_reviews.name: Nigel Dsouza
featured_reviews.review_text: The best place to get rented cycles. The owner is kind enough to provide air in the tyre, adjust your seat height or anything else you might need. You can try various cycles and the new cycle quality also is good. Price is abit on the higher side(Rs80/per hour). Rs60 would be good. But for long distance cycling this is highly recommended. Because you pay more but you get reliable cycles and no fear of breakdown. Opens at 6:30AM. Opening time could have been earlier maybe 5:30 or 6 in summer because we have to ride in the sun. But overall a very good place to rent a cycle.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thanks Nigel for your kind words. We will definitely work on your valuable feedback. Keep Pedaling!!
